lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: We'll never be able to defeat the Raptures at this rate.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: The Raptures are infinite, while we're finite in number.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: A grounded assessment, to be sure.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: So, we have to go big.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: That's the only way we'll be able to turn the tide.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Did you have anything in mind?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: I believe so. No, actually, I'm certain I do.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: But it will be incredibly difficult. Close to impossible, in fact.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: But we have to make it happen.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: As the Goddesses, we must protect humanity.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: What's your plan? Do you think we stand a chance?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Even if we didn't, we have to try.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: That's our job.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: So, Red Shoes.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Never give up.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: I'll take the first step.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: All you have to do is follow me.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: I'll become humanity's savior.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: I need you on my side.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: I have to go. We'll meet again.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: ... Goodbye. Rapunzel. I wish you luck.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Having hope in a situation where you can't win...

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Wouldn't siding with the Raptures solve this problem?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: At first, Corruption was a bagatelle, something trivial which momentarily paralyzed Nikkes.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: However, the way it operated was somewhat unorthodox.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: It didn't affect the nervous system, nor any other part of the body.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: So I was curious as to how it could induce paralysis.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Every Nikke's brain has something called a NIMPH. Have you heard of it?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: It injects information into the brain and then backs up all the information contained within the brain.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: In the initial stage, Corruption forces its way into this NIMPH to issue a command not to move.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: The important thing was that it touched the NIMPH. It's that simple.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: This is where I saw the future.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: A future where we don't lose. A future where humanity wins this war.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: It's simple.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: We simply need to be on the same side.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I didn't have the necessary skills to affect the NIMPH, so I started investigating this Corruption phenomenon.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: And I discovered something remarkable. Corruption comprises a code that even humans can understand.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: This was a revelation.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I tried inputting simple commands from the Corruption process into the Nikkes.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: You know what happened? They started moving according to the command that was input.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: It was fascinating.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: So I implanted my own personality data into the Corruption code, and modified it to have the subject think in the same manner as a Rapture.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: This was also a resounding success.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: The Nikkes infected by the Corruption only repeated actions which were beneficial to the Raptures.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I was overwhelmed with joy. I had discovered a way for humanity to coexist with the Raptures.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: The Raptures are our enemy. An enemy we must defeat.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: But, if we switch our way of thinking and proceed with the mindset that Raptures are our allies,

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: then we don't need to fight anymore.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: We can truly achieve harmony.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: But there was a big problem.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: The Corruption injected with my personality had very obvious limitations.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: It didn't last long.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: It either got attacked by the NIMPH and died or physically destroyed the brain.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: My personality data was inferior and unable to perform a diverse range of actions.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I had gone as far as I could with my own skillset. I became painfully aware of my limitations.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I implanted this improved Corruption code

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: in the Raptures and returned them.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I trusted the Raptures.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: If the Raptures had achieved such incredible evolutionary progress in a short period, with this improved Corruption code,

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I firmly believed that they would be able to hone it to perfection.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: And they did not disappoint.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: When the Raptures returned with the new-and-improved Corruption code, I felt as if I had the entire world in the palm of my hand.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Although it had become something unique to Raptures, something that humans could not understand, it was perfection personified.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: That was what created you.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Anachiro, the fruit of my labor.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: That was how the Raptures responded to the peace treaty I sent out.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I proposed that we could live together in harmony.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: You, Anachiro, are a symbol of peace between the Raptures and humanity.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: You are a perfect being.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: The most beautiful being.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: If you had a beastly beauty when you were corrupted,

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: now, your beauty is absolute.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Tell me more. Tell me everything about yourself.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: How are you feeling? Do you still want to live for the Raptures?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: How does it feel when you see a Nikke? Is there a difference from before?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Do you sleep? Can you taste? Do the Raptures attack you? Do you feel like you are out of place?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Do you want to kill humans? Do you want to save them? Do you still hear voices? How long can you hold your breath?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Tell me. Tell me everything, Anachiro. Please.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I have a question.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Ahh, questions are also good. What is it?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Are you the one who implanted the Corruption in me?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Yes. I did it during your last maintenance check...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Why me?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Because you're the most perfect Nikke amongst us.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: The result of the Rapture-improved Corruption combined with your perfection.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I had no doubt that the results would be sublime.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: The Raptures realized that too. That's why they modified you to be omnipotent.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: The ultimate masterpiece, jointly created by me, the Raptures, and Abe.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Is such beauty even moral? It's almost blasphemous!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Did you do this to the others as well?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: No. Not yet.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I didn't want to waste any precious subjects until I confirmed your outcome.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: When did you come up with the idea of coexisting with the Raptures?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: A while ago. When I was still human.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Why did you apply to become a Grimms model?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: In order to spread my beliefs, I required power.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I had to climb up the ranks.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Rather than coming from a priest or V.T.C. researcher, the words of a Goddess would carry much more influence.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Are you saying you want to infect all Nikkes?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: How have you not been found out yet?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I'm aware that others would consider me insane.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: It's that awareness that has allowed me to remain undetected.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I was surprised that they wanted to do a brain scan, but it didn't amount to much.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Anachiro.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: It's destiny.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: How else could everything have fallen into place so perfectly?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: You must guide me. You must guide everyone.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: On the Heretic path. On the path to harmony.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: One last question.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Please, ask.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Is there a reason why I shouldn't kill you now?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Because I'm going to help you.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Now we can begin to walk the path toward peaceful coexistence with the Raptures.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Not many people will understand. But I will see my plan through.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I simply need you to remain a symbolic figure.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I'll take care of everything else.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: So, Anachiro. With m...
*Shoosh*
A beam of light from Glass Slippers pierces through Red Shoes' core.
She collapses lifelessly to the ground.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... Don't call me that.
Cinderella lowers her head and cradles her face in her hands,
sobbing silently.
*Clank clank*
Cinderella quickly raises her head.
Red Shoes is moving.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: How... I pierced her core straight through.
*Crack* *Craaaack*
Both of Red Shoes' legs twist and contort at unnatural angles.
She then charges at Cinderella while frantically swinging her appendages.
*Craaaaaash*
The flailing legs ceaselessly pound on Glass Slippers.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Her appendages are moving even after the main body has been taken out?!
Red Shoes moves like a marionette with the strings detached.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Hyah!
Glass Slippers fires a light beam,
severing both of Red Shoes' legs from her body,
like a sword through the air.
*Thud*
Red Shoes once again falls lifelessly to the floor.
The two detached legs
wander around aimlessly, as if lost and not knowing where to go.
After a while, they disappear into the darkness.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: *Huff*...! *Huff*...!

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Ah... Ahh...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You're still breathing?!

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Ahhhhh...

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Oh... how happy I would be to be turned into a Heretic.
Red Shoes' eyes grow faint as her life slips away,
and her movement ceases.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: It was you...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: This is all because of you!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You've caused all this pain and misery!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Damn you!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Ahhhhhhhhhhh!!

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Cinderella?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Red Shoes!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Is she dead?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Explain!
Cinderella looks around with trembling eyes.
The room which is in shambles.
Red Shoes' corpse, with her legs amputated and a hole in her chest.
And her, standing beside the body.
The faces of her comrades, unable to hide their fear and horror.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Did... did you do this?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: No, it's not...

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Cinderella...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: It wasn't me!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I... I mean, I did this to her,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: but she was trying to corrupt...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: She said that the Corruption was her doing.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: She was trying to use it to...

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: Glass Slippers is solid, so I'll use acid.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Roger.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: Let's kill this Heretic.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: No! I'm not a Heretic. I'm not Anachiro anymore!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: It's me, Cinderella!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Let me ask you a question then.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: You're saying Red Shoes is behind this Corruption, and it was her who planted it inside you?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Th-that's right. I can explain every...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Do you really expect us to believe that?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: There's no way Red Shoes would do something like that!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ahhhh!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You feel the same way, Siren?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Then what about me?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: What about me? You think I would kill Red Shoes without cause?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Why isn't anyone hearing out my side of the story?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Why I did it or what happened?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'm back. I'm all better now.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Why don't you believe me?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Why didn't any of you?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: When I saw you all a while ago,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: why didn't anyone ask if I was okay?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: When you all look at me, what do you see?
Cinderella's question is greeted with silence.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... Okay. I understand now.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Even after what I put you through, you were willing to meet with me.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'm grateful for that.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: But I guess I had the wrong impression.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You simply wanted to see a monster.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You wanted to hurt a monster.
Cinderella begins to levitate.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Cinderella!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Don't follow me,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: or I'll kill you where you stand.
Cinderella disappears,
leaving her former colleagues standing amongst the ruined room.
They silently stare up at the sky, where Cinderella disappeared.
